title: Between the Trees
description: Pink trumpet trees bloom across the Adriatic coast of Montenegro in late spring and early summer, creating a spectacle of flowers across the region. "The pink trumpet tree was everywhere in Kotor, lining the shoreline and creating these portals to the beach," says photographer Brendan George Ko. "The pink flowers pair beautifully with the turquoise waters of Kotor Bay." The area is known for its mountainous national parks.
translated_description: 春末夏初，黑山亚得里亚海沿岸的粉花风铃木竞相绽放，形成一片繁花似锦的壮丽景象。摄影师布伦丹·乔治·科描述道："科托尔城内随处可见粉花风铃木，它们沿着海岸线排列，形成通往海滩的天然拱廊。粉色的花朵与科托尔湾碧绿的海水相映成趣。"该地区以多山的国家公园而闻名。
